# Yiruo Xu

> Postdoctoral fellow in Earth and Environmental Sciences and Astronomy at the University of Michigan. Petrologist and geochemist studying the history of the solid Earth.

Research interests: petrology, geochemistry, tectonics, cosmochemistry. Uses diffusion models to constrain the timescales of metamorphic processes and phase-equilibrium models to predict the compositions of condensed solids in protoplanetary disks.
